CA.rationale: No explicit attention/content processing relation present.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates (red/blue), an explicit presentation pattern, and a separate origin/status field are all present for the same candidate referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linked to content presentation/emergence/access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (color-labeled coordinate sets) are present.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields are provided separately from the content coordinate lists, distinguishing identification from status.

O.rationale: The report states how content is presented (coordinate sets, grid orientation) and includes pattern organization for candidate/current referents.
